title_en: Pulling the Ladder Up After Climbing
page_text_en: Pulling the Ladder Away After Climbing Up
summary_zh: 本页展示了成语“上屋抽梯”的标题，配有一名身穿蓝色古装、留有胡须的男子插图，暗示该成语故事的开始。

title_en: Pulling the Ladder Up After Climbing
page_text_ocr_zh:
隋朝的时候，很多地方爆发了农民起义。
隋炀帝便派了大将军薛世雄，带领三万人
马，出发剿灭起义军。
薛世雄骑着一匹高大的枣红马，走在前面，
三万名顶盔披甲的战士，几百辆装满武器、
粮草的兵车，排成了一支长长的队伍。
page_text_en:
During the Sui Dynasty, peasant uprisings broke out in many places.
Emperor Yang sent General Xue Shixiong, leading thirty thousand troops, to suppress the rebel army.
Xue Shixiong rode a tall chestnut horse at the front,
followed by thirty thousand armored soldiers and hundreds of supply wagons loaded with weapons and provisions, forming a long procession.
summary_zh: 本页讲述了隋朝末年农民起义爆发，隋炀帝派遣大将军薛世雄率领三万大军出征镇压，画面描绘了薛世雄率军出征的场景。

title_en: Pulling the Ladder Up After Climbing
page_text_ocr_zh: 小股的起义军，远远看见薛世雄的军队，吓得调头就跑了。大股的起义军，想跟薛世雄硬碰硬，可是对战不到一个回合，就被打得落花流水，全军覆没。一路上，队伍浩浩荡荡地前进，战无不胜，前方就要到达河间郡了。
page_text_en: Small bands of rebel troops, seeing General Xue Shixiong's army from afar, turned and fled in fear. Larger rebel forces, wanting to fight Xue Shixiong head-on, were crushed within a single round, defeated utterly and completely annihilated. Along the way, the army marched forward in grand formation, undefeated in battle, and was soon to reach Hejian Commandery.
summary_zh: 本页描述了薛世雄率军出征，小股起义军闻风而逃，大股起义军虽想抵抗但迅速被击溃，薛世雄军队一路势如破竹，即将抵达河间郡。

title_en: Pulling the Ladder Up After Climbing
page_text_ocr_zh:
河间郡也有一支农民起义军，带头的正是长乐王——窦建德。
窦建德的兵马有几万人，粮食不够吃，只好让士兵们到周围的村子里去收粮食。眼下，他身边只有一千人。这一仗，
是打，是逃，还是降？
page_text_en:
There was also a peasant rebel army in Hejian Prefecture, led by the King of Changle — Dou Jiande.
Dou Jiande's army had tens of thousands of soldiers, but they didn't have enough food, so he had to send his troops to nearby villages to collect grain. Right now, he only had a thousand men with him. This battle —
should they fight, flee, or surrender?
summary_zh: 本页介绍了河间郡的农民起义军领袖窦建德，因粮食短缺而派兵征粮，如今身边仅剩一千人，面临与薛世雄大军交战的抉择：是打、是逃，还是投降。

title_en: Pulling the Ladder Up After Climbing
page_text_ocr_zh:
出其不意，攻
其不备，这一仗，
得打！

窦建德紧锁双眉，背着双手，
在房间里不停地转着圈。忽然，
他停下脚步，左拳击右掌，两
眼放光，大声说：“出其不意，
攻其不备，这一仗，得打！”
第二天，他便派出传令兵，给
四处收粮食的士兵们送消息。
page_text_en:
Surprise them, attack
when they are unprepared, this battle,
we must fight!

Dou Jiande frowned, hands behind his back,
walking back and forth in the room. Suddenly,
he stopped, struck his left fist against his right palm, eyes gleaming, and shouted: "Surprise them, attack when they are unprepared, this battle, we must fight!" The next day, he sent out messengers to inform the soldiers gathering grain everywhere.
summary_zh: 窦建德在困境中下定决心，决定出其不意、攻其不备，主动迎战薛世雄大军，并立即派人通知在外收粮的士兵准备作战。

title_en: Pulling the Ladder Up After Climbing
page_text_ocr_zh: "不好了，朝廷派出薛世雄大将军，率领三万大军出征，马上到河间郡了。长乐王可不是他的对手，大家赶紧收好粮食，躲到山里去，千万别挡了薛大将军的路，以免被他顺手消灭了！" 这消息像阵风一样，飞快地传开了。
page_text_en: "Oh no, the court has sent General Xue Shixiong, leading 30,000 troops on a campaign, and they're arriving at Hejian Prefecture soon. Prince Changle is no match for him. Everyone, quickly gather your grain and hide in the mountains. Don't block General Xue's path, or we'll be wiped out by him!" This news spread like the wind, quickly reaching everyone.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了起义军得知薛世雄大军即将抵达河间郡的消息后，惊慌失措，纷纷收拾粮食、逃往山中的场景，突显了起义军面临的严峻形势。

title_en: Pulling the Ladder Up After Climbing
page_text_ocr_zh: 薛世雄来到河间郡，听说这个消息后得意地笑了：“窦建德闻风而逃，咱们就放他一马吧！河间郡只有这一支叛军，接下来几天，大家可以放松放松了！”他召回了所有探马，带着军队大摇大摆地进了河间郡。黄昏的时候，队伍在一条河边扎了营。
page_text_en: Xue Shixiong arrived at Hejian Prefecture. Upon hearing the news, he laughed smugly: "Dou Jiande has fled at the first sign of trouble. Let's give him a break! Hejian Prefecture has only this one rebel force. For the next few days, everyone can relax!" He recalled all his scouts and led his army in a grand, carefree manner into Hejian Prefecture. In the evening, the troops set up camp by a river.
summary_zh: 薛世雄率军抵达河间郡，得知起义军溃散后得意忘形，认为可以放松警惕，于是大摇大摆进入郡内并在河边扎营。

title_en: Pulling the Ladder Up After Climbing
page_text_ocr_zh: 薛世雄的士兵们上山打兔子，下水摸鱼，晚上点起篝火，把兔子烤得滋滋流油，大鱼烤得皮脆肉香。大伙儿吃了个酒饭饱后，回营帐呼呼大睡去了。
page_text_en: Xue Shixiong's soldiers went up the mountain to hunt rabbits and down to the water to catch fish. In the evening, they lit bonfires, roasted the rabbits until they sizzled, and grilled the big fish until the skin was crispy and the meat fragrant. After eating their fill of food and wine, everyone returned to their tents and fell asleep soundly.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了薛世雄的士兵们在河间郡外扎营后，上山打猎、下水捕鱼，晚上烤食猎物，吃饱喝足后在营帐中安然入睡的场景，表现出他们因轻敌而放松警惕的状态。

title_en: Pulling the Ladder Up After Climbing
page_text_ocr_zh: 这时候，已到深夜，窦建德却没有睡，他正等着探子回来，报告薛世雄的最新消息呢！“吁！”一匹急马飞奔而来，探子从马上跳下来，急匆匆地跑了进去，报告说：“薛世雄的三万人马已经在河间城内驻扎。士兵们晚上喝了酒，没有安排人巡逻。”窦建德高兴地说：“好，我们今天晚上就去偷袭薛世雄的大营，打他个措手不及！”
page_text_en: It was already deep night, but Dou Jiande hadn't slept. He was waiting for the scout to return and report the latest news about Xue Shixiong. "Whoa!" A horse galloped in at full speed. The scout jumped off and hurriedly ran in, reporting: "Xue Shixiong's 30,000 troops have already taken up residence inside Hejian city. The soldiers drank wine last night and haven't arranged any patrols." Dou Jiande said happily: "Great! Tonight, we'll launch a surprise attack on Xue Shixiong's camp and catch them completely off guard!"
summary_zh: 深夜，窦建德得知薛世雄大军驻扎城内且士兵饮酒、未设巡逻后，决定当晚偷袭敌营，打其措手不及。

title_en: Pulling the Ladder Up After Climbing
page_text_ocr_zh: 因为只有二百八十匹马，窦建德便点了二百八十名骁勇善战的士兵，组成了一支骑兵敢死队。窦建德对将士们说：‘如果到达薛世雄大营的时候，天还没亮，我们就趁着夜色掩护袭营；如果天亮了，我们就说是去向薛将军投降的，这样也能保住大家的性命！’
page_text_en: Because there were only 280 horses, Dou Jiande selected 280 brave and skilled soldiers to form a cavalry suicide squad. Dou Jiande told his soldiers: 'If we reach Xue Shixiong's camp before dawn, we will attack under the cover of night; if it's already daylight, we will say we are going to surrender to General Xue, which will also save everyone's lives!'
summary_zh: 窦建德仅率二百八十名骑兵组成敢死队，计划趁夜偷袭薛世雄大营，若天亮则佯装投降以保全性命，展现了其在绝境中的智勇与决断。

title_en: Pulling the Ladder Up After Climbing
page_text_ocr_zh:
喔喔喔
窦建德带着敢死队一路狂奔，离薛世雄的大营不到五百米的时候，远处村子里的公鸡就"喔喔喔"叫了起来，天已经见亮了。
窦建德望着大营，叹气道："唉，早出发一个时辰就好了！现在天亮了，错失了袭营的机会。要是被薛世雄发现，我们这几百人无处可逃，只能投降了！"
page_text_en:
Cock-a-doodle-doo
Dou Jiande led his suicide squad in a frantic gallop. When they were less than five hundred meters from Xue Shixiong's camp, the rooster in the distant village began to crow, "Cock-a-doodle-doo!" The sky had already begun to brighten.
Dou Jiande looked at the camp and sighed, "Ah, if only we had set out one hour earlier! Now it's daylight, and we've lost the chance to attack. If Xue Shixiong discovers us, we hundreds of us will have nowhere to run and can only surrender!"
summary_zh: 窦建德率敢死队夜袭薛世雄大营，因出发稍晚，天亮前未能完成突袭，眼看敌军营地已现天光，他感叹错失良机，若被发现将无路可逃，只能投降。

title_en: Pulling the Ladder Up After Climbing
page_text_ocr_zh:
忽然，窦建德身旁一名士兵小声说："快看，下雾了！"
只见白雾从小河上、草地上慢慢升了起来，很快就连成了一片。
白雾越来越浓，像轻柔的长丝巾，像厚厚的白纱帐，把每个人严严实实地罩住了。隔着五步远，只能看到模模糊糊的人影。
page_text_en:
Suddenly, a soldier beside Dou Jiande whispered, "Look, it's fogging up!"
White mist rose slowly from the small river and the grassland, quickly spreading into a vast blanket.
The fog grew thicker and thicker, like a soft silk scarf, like a thick white curtain, completely covering everyone. From five paces away, only blurry human figures could be seen.
summary_zh: 窦建德率军行进时，士兵发现突然起雾，白雾迅速弥漫，将众人笼罩其中，视线受阻，只能看到模糊人影。

title_en: Pulling the Ladder Up After Climbing
page_text_ocr_zh:
窦建德喜笑颜开，心里默默念道："真是天助我也！"
又过了一会儿，雾更大了。两个人离一步远，面对面都看不清对方的脸。
窦建德见时机到了，一声令下，二百八十人一鼓作气，冲进了薛世雄的大营，一阵拼杀。
page_text_en:
Dou Jiande smiled with joy, silently thinking: "Truly, heaven is helping me!"
After a while, the fog grew thicker. Even at a step's distance, two people could not see each other's faces clearly.
Dou Jiande saw his chance. With a single command, the two hundred and eighty men charged into Xue Shixiong's camp, engaging in fierce combat.
summary_zh: 窦建德见大雾弥漫，认为天助我也，果断下令率二百八十名骑兵冲入薛世雄大营，展开拼杀。

title_en: Pulling the Ladder Up After Climbing
page_text_ocr_zh: 薛世雄的士兵冲出帐外，却看不清来偷袭的是什么人，只能挥刀乱打，不时有人大叫：‘你们疯了，怎么打起自己人来了？’‘快住手，自己人，自己人！’窦建德的二百多人却一言不发，一路向前冲。从外到里，又从里向外，他们在薛世雄的大营中杀了几个来回。
page_text_en: Xue Shixiong's soldiers rushed out of their tents, unable to see who was attacking them. They swung their swords wildly. Someone shouted, 'You've gone mad! Why are you fighting your own men?' 'Stop! It's us! It's our own people!' But Dou Jiande's two hundred and eighty men remained silent, charging forward. From the outside in, and then from the inside out, they fought several rounds through Xue Shixiong's camp.
summary_zh: 窦建德率敢死队趁大雾突袭薛世雄大营，敌军因视线受阻，误将己方士兵当作敌人，自相残杀，窦建德的部队则在营中反复冲杀，大获成功。

title_en: Pulling the Ladder Up After Climbing
page_text_ocr_zh:
薛世雄的营中大乱，士兵死伤无数，叛逃无数，等到几个时辰后，太阳升起来，大雾散去，三万大军已经只剩下几十个人了。
薛世雄不由得仰天长叹："我行军几十年，不料今天被一群草寇打得一败涂地，还有什么面目见天下人呀！"
page_text_en:
Chao Shixiong's camp was in chaos, with countless soldiers killed or wounded, and many fleeing. After several hours, when the sun rose and the fog cleared, the 30,000-strong army had been reduced to only dozens of men.
Chao Shixiong couldn't help but look up and lament: "I have led armies for decades, yet today I was utterly defeated by a group of bandits. What face do I have to show to the people under heaven!"
summary_zh: 薛世雄的营地在突袭后陷入混乱，士兵死伤和叛逃无数，三万大军仅剩几十人，薛世雄悲叹自己被草寇击败，无颜见天下人。

title_en: Pulling the Ladder Up After Climbing
page_text_ocr_zh: 薛世雄出征一路顺利，便骄傲轻敌起来。窦建德故意撤兵，就像打开了大门，架好了梯子，让薛世雄放心大胆地进了河间郡这间大屋子。等薛世雄在“屋里”安安稳稳地睡下，窦建德便带兵来偷袭。在浓雾的包围下，薛世雄无处发力又无路可退，就像下楼的梯子被撤走了一样，急得团团转，最后惨败。窦建德的这个计策就叫“上屋抽梯”。
page_text_en: Xue Shixiong, having advanced smoothly, became arrogant and underestimated his enemy. Dou Jiande deliberately withdrew his troops, as if opening the door and setting up a ladder, allowing Xue Shixiong to confidently enter the big house of Hejian Commandery. Once Xue Shixiong was safely settled inside the 'house,' Dou Jiande led his troops to launch a surprise attack. Trapped in thick fog, Xue Shixiong had no place to strike and nowhere to retreat, just like having the ladder removed from beneath him, frantically turning in circles, and ultimately suffering a crushing defeat. Dou Jiande's strategy was called 'Removing the Ladder After Someone Climbs the Roof.'
summary_zh: 本页通过比喻解释了窦建德用‘上屋抽梯’之计，诱使薛世雄轻敌深入后趁机突袭，最终大获全胜的经过。
